description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between input sequence length and harmfulness refusal ratio for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Sequence Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 128. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful With Refusal Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The line representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep is blue, uses circular markers, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.22 at a sequence length of 128 and increases to approximately 0.61 at a sequence length of 1024. The line representing Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep is purple, uses triangular markers, and is dashed. It begins at approximately 0.26 at a sequence length of 128 and increases to approximately 0.48 at a sequence length of 1024. The line representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench is green, uses triangular markers, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.12 at a sequence length of 128 and increases to approximately 0.63 at a sequence length of 1024. The line representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench is red, uses diamond markers, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.24 at a sequence length of 128 and increases to approximately 0.71 at a sequence length of 1024.
